dogecoin.text:
Community

If there’s one thing we have learned about Dogecoin, BAYC, etc. is to never underestimate community. The Doge community has been fading away recently but can no doubt make a huge comeback and make some noise when things start pumping.
If Coinbase somehow integrates the fractionalization of the Dogecoin meme NFT (maybe by listing $DOG) onto their platform we can see loads of retail money pouring in.
